Definition: Abiram, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abiram is the name of two Israelites. One joins Korah’s rebellion against Moses and Aaron, and the earth opens and swallows him with Dathan; the other is the firstborn son of Hiel, who dies when his father rebuilds Jericho — ‘he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn’, fulfilling Joshua’s curse.
TheologicalSignificance: Two men, one name, and both die for rebellion — one against Moses, one against the word spoken over Jericho. I believe Abiram's name is a double warning: the earth keeps the record of those who rise against God's appointed leaders, and a curse spoken by God does not fade with time.
